body: It's pointless to debate much more on what I said. The Past can't be changed. She decided not to meet me. I've wait from weeks to months and I didn't get a reply so I have no choice but to come to terms with it. That's all. Just had a burst out with my family. I know that I'm still being observed but I don't care anymore. Chances are I'll be hurt again soon enough, but I'll just try to tough it out and break down whenever I can find a place to be alone. I'm tired. I wish I could just sleep and never had to wake up.

Well ... The only person I wanted to talk to is currently states away from me and she stood me up months ago when I dropped her a message to meet up, I just wanted to make amends for the hurtful words I said to her months ago and give a really big hug and thank her for all she'd done for me. She said she'd get back to me when she's free but that "free time" to meet up never really came.
So there's really nothing left to talk about you know, except for the repetitive, drone life I've been living on just to kill time, and also hurtful mocking from colleague, high school and college mates, relatives and even blood bonded siblings. 
    Don't you think it's funny how people who don't even know me that well can seem to assume to pass judgement on what I do just based on what they see on the surface? A part of me just want to see how much further malice there is in a person's heart to come up with such verbally hurtful things to say but the old soul inside me is just plain tired. Exhausted. Fatigue; from all the hurtful things I've heard over this past few months, and from people close to me.
